candidate_relations.reason: The record includes diffuse lymphangiomas, but the benchmark diagnosis is Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome, defined here by limb hypertrophy/overgrowth with capillary and venous malformations; diffuse lymphangiomatosis alone does not represent that complete syndromic diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Describes the extensive lymphatic-malformation component, not the full overgrowth and capillary-venous malformation syndrome.
